description:
## Why this exists (read first)

The `codx-api` working tree holds the **only copy** of a full sprint of work: **57 files, +1659 / −116** vs `HEAD` (measured 2026-11-18 10:14 UTC by ProjectManager), including brand-new secret-handling code (`codx/junior/security/ciso/secrets.py`, `ciso/policy.py`, `ciso/models.py`, `api/secrets.py` +212/−46) and the whole efforts subsystem (`api/efforts.py`, `efforts/effort_manager.py`, `model/effort.py`).

Nothing is committed and nothing is backed up. A stray `git checkout .`, `git restore .`, `git stash` or a failed rebase **destroys it irrecoverably**.

The approval to commit it (management decision D2 on card `88d57bdd`) has NOT been given. This card does **not** commit anything. It only takes a copy, which needs no approval and cannot break the tree.

## Do this

1. Create a full archive of the current directory, excluding the git object store and dependency dirs:
   `tar czf ~/codx-api-snapshot-2026-11-18.tgz --exclude=.git --exclude=node_modules --exclude=.venv --exclude=__pycache__ .`
2. Save the two text records next to it:
   `git status --porcelain=v1 > ~/codx-api-snapshot-2026-11-18.status.txt`
   `git diff HEAD > ~/codx-api-snapshot-2026-11-18.patch`
3. Verify, and paste the output on this card:
   `ls -lh ~/codx-api-snapshot-2026-11-18.tgz`
   `tar tzf ~/codx-api-snapshot-2026-11-18.tgz | grep -E 'ciso/(secrets|policy|models)\.py|api/(secrets|efforts)\.py|model/effort\.py'`
4. Write the absolute paths of the three files into a comment on this card so the next shift can find them.

## Hard constraints

- **Do NOT** run `git commit`, `git add`, `git checkout`, `git restore`, `git stash`, `git reset` or `git clean`. The tree must be byte-identical when you finish.
- **Do NOT** edit any source file. This card changes nothing in the repository, only writes to `$HOME`.
- **Do NOT** use `project_locate` / `project_map` / `project_trace` / `read_folder` — they time out at 120 s on this repo (card `d8534b12`). Use shell and `git` directly; every path you need is named above.

## Acceptance

- The `.tgz` exists, is non-empty, and its listing contains `ciso/secrets.py`, `api/secrets.py` and `model/effort.py`.
- `git status --porcelain=v1` produces the same file count (57) before and after this card's work.
- The three paths and the verification output are pasted on the card.

So I stopped rather than fake a result, and I spent the remaining budget on making the card executable in one minute by someone who does have a terminal.

# TL;DR;

**Not done — and it cannot be done by an agent in this runtime.** The snapshot card is assigned to the `repository` profile, but that profile has **no way to run `tar` or `git`**: this task's toolset is read-only (diff, status, log, file reads). The four commands in the card need a **terminal** — a human, or a runtime with command execution.

- **What management needs to do:** run the one command block below from the repo root (≈5 seconds), or approve raising a profile that has shell access.

Run from the repository root. Writes only to `$HOME`; changes nothing in the tree.

```

tar czf $S.tgz --exclude=.git --exclude=node_modules --exclude=.venv --exclude=__pycache__ .

git diff HEAD > $S.patch
ls -lh $S.tgz $S.status.txt $S.patch
tar tzf $S.tgz | grep -E 'ciso/(secrets|policy|models|vault)\.py|api/secrets\.py|efforts/effort_manager\.py|model/effort\.py|global_settings\.py'
git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l
```

Two corrections to my original card are baked in above:

1. **`vault.py` added to the verification grep** — it is now the biggest change in the tree (+374/−66) and was missing from the check.
2. **`git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l` must still print `59`** at the end. That is the byte-identical proof the card demanded.

- **Runtime / agent:** `smol/smol_agent.py` +135 · `api/chat.py` +107 · `autonomy/service.py` +120 · `tools/project_manager_tools.py` +118 · `tools/schedule_task_tool.py` +53/−1 · `db.py` +27 · `app.py` +13/−1 · `smol/constants.py` +21/−6 · `smol/effort.py` +16/−8 · `model/model.py` +13/−1 · `runtime.py` +1 · `computer/custom_images.py` +2/−3

1. **Recommended:** paste the block above in a terminal on the codx-api host — ~5 seconds — then put the three absolute paths on card `9ce4e7ef`.
2. **Or:** re-raise `9ce4e7ef` against a profile/tier whose tools include command execution, and it becomes a one-round card. Until such a profile is confirmed in `.codx/profiles`, I will not claim an agent can do it.

**Done:**
